title: add downgrade-guard, version-pinning, backup/restore and transactional schema migrations for private-installer
author: Asha Kapoor
description: This PR adds a comprehensive set of upgrade/rollback safeguards and tooling for the private installer (VPC/on-prem): 1) a downgrade-guard that prevents automatic downgrades when incompatible schema changes are present, 2) version-pinning for all helm charts and terraform modules consumed by the installer, 3) a documented backup-and-restore workflow integrated with the installer (Postgres and object storage), and 4) transactional Postgres schema migrations for critical components with a preflight validation step. Motivation: customers running Private deployments have experienced risky upgrades during staged rollouts and manual rollbacks. The goal is to make upgrades safe and automatable while preserving a clear path for rollbacks when needed. The changes include: - A runtime downgrade_guard controller that checks schema version annotations and installed chart pins before allowing an upgrade/rollback operation. - HelmChart values and templates updated to accept and enforce explicit chart and image tags via a new version_pinning.yaml manifest and CI-enforced policy. - Terraform modules updated with state locking and pinned provider versions; added module input to surface current deployed versions. - Backup/restore scripts and k8s Job templates for consistent logical backups (pg_dump/pg_basebackup flow) and verified restores in a sandbox path. - Transactional migrations implemented using a migration runner that performs each step in a transaction where supported and includes safe roll-forward/rollback SQL artifacts. - A preflight check (redwoodctl preflight upgrade) that runs backups, validates chart pins, runs schema dry-run, and emits a human-readable rollback plan. - Docs and runbook for operators describing upgrade sequencing, emergency rollback steps, and SLO implications. Migration path: feature branch includes a lightweight operator that will be deployed as part of the private-installer upgrade; operators must run the preflight check before enabling automated upgrades. Rollback plan: if preflight fails or post-upgrade health checks fail, the upgrade is aborted; if manual rollback is needed, the runbook provides steps to restore Postgres and reapply pinned Helm charts. Testing and validation: integration tests added to perf-canary and private-installer CI that perform simulated upgrades on a test cluster, verify backups, and attempt controlled rollbacks. The CI enforces version pinning via a lint check. Backwards compatibility: installs created before this change are supported but we require one-time migration to annotate current schema versions (scripts included). Related: ENG-4126 (upgrade safety), ENG-4190 (private-installer hardening), SUP-2387 (customer incident leading to this work).
commits: Initial implementation of downgrade_guard controller and preflight checks
Add version_pinning.yaml and enforce chart/image tags in helm templates
Terraform: pin providers and expose deployed_version outputs
Backup/restore: add k8s Job templates and restore validation
Add transactional migration runner and migration SQL artifacts
Add integration tests and update CI lint for version pinning
Docs: runbook and operator guide for upgrades/rollbacks
